messages:
sam: Quick heads-up 1: were scheduling a base-image rebuild next week. Blocks: RBAC for new KMS key, audit retention for signing events, vuln triage for canary hosts. Who can pick RBAC?

priya: I can take RBAC. Which key ID?

sam: Using `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/runtime/cryptoKeys/sign-v5`. Its created but locked to sec-admins. We need to grant the builder SA signing rights and the publisher SA read-only for public keys.

marta: For audit retention, compliance asked for 18 months for signing events. Current sink 365d. ops-bot: storage impact?

ops-bot: estimate: +0.5TB/yr to extend kms-audit-sink to 540d, charged to infra-audit center.

priya: Ill add scoped binding: `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` only on the cryptoKey to `ci-builder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Also will add `roles/cloudkms.viewer` for `image-publisher`. Drafting PR.

marta: For vuln triage, propose canary = 20 hosts in `us-central1-a`, daily scans for 7 days. sec-bot: schedule?

sec-bot: scheduled: image-scan `runtime-base:v2026-03-24` -> cohort `canary-20-us` at 02:00 UTC daily for 7 days.

sam: Incident plan check: if key compromised -> revoke key version, mark signed artifacts untrusted, emergency rollout of golden image signed by emergency key, notify per SLA. Anyone own emergency key policy?

priya: I can draft emergency key policy (multi-approver process). PR will include IAM changes, sink retention request, and runtime agent pubkey-cache TTL bump.

marta: Ill add dashboard and alert: `image-scan.sev2_count > 0 in 48h` -> page security oncall.

sam: Thanks. PR link when posted please. Canary start Mon 02:00 UTC.
